slices.notes: HOLD_PRESS_TIME=150. Presses at 130/145/150/155/170ms. Hold only fires at 170ms; 150/155ms produce tap. Effective boundary is HOLD_PRESS_TIME + ~1 poll interval (~8-16ms). Poll-granularity caveat for converter.

DBL_PRESS_WINDOW=150. Gaps 140/150/160ms (down-to-down) all fire double. Window reference appears to be release-to-down, not down-to-down. Needs wider probe (200/250ms gaps). Escalated to orchestrator.

ZR_MODE=NO_SKIP. Staged pull: soft then full sequentially. Instant 0->255 jump: soft + full both fire (~3ms apart). Confirms cross-runtime delta vs Steam (Steam instant jump: full only, no soft). Phase 4 adversarial material.
L=LSHIFT,R=E,L+R=Q. Sticky state confirmed at 100/300/1000ms gaps — persistent, not a short race. Extends jsm_lane_behavior.md finding (was 600-700ms; now 1000ms confirmed).
